FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ElectraSupply Solutions specializes in the wholesale distribution of UL-listed electrical components, primarily serving residential and light commercial markets. Our operations focus on providing high-quality electrical supplies, including wiring, switches, outlets, and lighting products, ensuring compliance with all necessary regulatory requirements. We pride ourselves on maintaining a robust inventory management system and strong vendor relationships, allowing us to deliver reliable products to our customers. Additionally, our team emphasizes safety and compliance by adhering to the National Electrical Code (NEC) and other local standards. We do not engage in the manufacturing or installation of equipment outside our specified product range, nor do we deal in unlisted or counterfeit products, ensuring that our offerings meet the highest safety and quality standards. We continually invest in cyber security protocols to protect customer and payment data, further enhancing the trust our customers place in us.
